description: Runs daily at 9am, compares today's analytics metrics to the 30-day average, and sends an alert email if any metric spikes 2x or drops below 50%.
name: AEJaCA Anomaly Alert

parameters.query:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT session) FILTER (WHERE ts >= CURRENT_DATE) AS visitors_today,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'page' AND ts >= CURRENT_DATE) AS pageviews_today,
  COUNT(DISTINCT session) FILTER (WHERE category = 'inquiry' AND ts >= CURRENT_DATE) AS inquiries_today,
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT session) FILTER (WHERE ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') / 30.0, 1) AS visitors_avg30,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'page' AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') / 30.0, 1) AS pageviews_avg30,
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT session) FILTER (WHERE category = 'inquiry' AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') / 30.0, 1) AS inquiries_avg30
FROM events
